name: What should I expect during my first personal training session at Cave Training?
description: The first session includes a consultation to discuss goals and an assessment to create a personalized, safe, and effective training plan.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during my first personal training session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your first personal training session typically begins with a consultation to discuss your fitness history, goals, and any physical limitations or injuries. This helps your trainer create a personalized plan. You can expect a fitness assessment to establish baseline measurements for strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular health. This preparation allows the trainer to design a program that is safe, effective, and tailored specifically for you, setting the foundation for your training journey.
